hypotheses.title: Power-Scaled Customer Network Return Inversion with Platform Decay
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Applies quadratic power scaling to inverted 10-day customer return signals within subindustries, combined with 15% short-term 3-day price mean-reversion. Sizing platform decay to 6 reduces turnover from 31% to under 20%, elevating Fitness above 1.00 and maintaining near-zero correlation to volatility and news alphas.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if customer return reversal dissipates or turnover exceeds 25%.

candidates.rationale: Power-scaled 10-day customer return inversion with 15% 3d close delta reversal
Dynamic branching customer return inversion with 3d delta and decay=6

hypotheses.title: Fundamental Quality Scaled by Idiosyncratic Risk
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Rewards companies with top fundamental quality scores (fscore_bfl_quality) relative to their idiosyncratic volatility (unsystematic_risk_last_90_days) within subindustries. High-quality low-idiosyncratic-risk firms deliver stable risk-adjusted compound returns orthogonal to sentiment and option factors.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if quality premiums are subsumed by systemic beta.

candidates.rationale: Power-scaled fundamental quality over 90-day unsystematic risk
